notes: Warehouse In / Out Ledger. Adds a derived warehouse-flow report beginning Aug 1 of each inventory year, with current Month, inventory-aligned Half-Year (H1 Aug-Jan / H2 Feb-Jul), and full Inventory Year (Aug 1-Jul 31) summaries. Counts completed physical inbound/outbound records already captured by Operations, Receiving, and reviewed Scan add/subtract history; internal preparation such as Carpet Cutting and Order Picking is not treated as warehouse door movement. Inventory Transfers are classified by direction. Mixed units are never incorrectly added together: Roll, Carton, Pail, Foot, etc. remain separate. Includes inbound/outbound line counts, quantities by unit, net-by-unit figures, and a 12-month breakdown. No new transaction database is created; the ledger reads existing Cloud Master-synchronized history.
